item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: GREEN DISH: patties, pan-fried yellow pea patties, served with fluffy mashed potatoes and topped with butter-roasted pumpkin. Served with pickled beetroot and wholegrain mustard. The dish is gluten free. (6+11)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Italian pearl barley risotto, a rustic, hearty take on the classic risotto, with pearl barley simmered in vegetable stock with dried porcini and fresh field mushrooms, butter and parmesan, topped with gremolata. Served with a bitter radicchio and endive salad in a light balsamic dressing. Also available gluten free. (1+6+11+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Red lentil and coconut milk dal, served with jasmine rice and raita. (6+7+8+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Oven-roasted aubergine with muhammara, baked onions and roasted chickpeas, topped with lime yoghurt and mint. (1+6+9+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Mediterranean bowl, crispy spiced chickpeas on a couscous salad with herbs and vegetables (tomato, cucumber and radish), topped with a red onion and red cabbage salad with sumac and served with pita bread. Served with hummus, tzatziki and chilli sauce. Also available gluten free and dairy free. (1+2+6+8+11+15)
